title: Borrow transition on the budget tape
statement: Let $W$ be a finite binary machine, $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $c,b\in\{0,1\}$, with the first administrative tape reading the tagged bit $b$. For any input symbol and tape contents satisfying that reading, the schedule machine's transition from the borrow phase with carry $c$ is the action that writes the tagged bit $b\oplus c$ on the budget tape, moves its head one cell to the right, leaves all other tapes and the input head stationary, emits no output, and enters the borrow phase with carry $c\wedge\lnot b$.
hypotheses_covered: Tape contents whose budget-tape symbol is the tagged bit $b$
replaced:
Let $W$ be a binary machine and $a$ a padding constant, and consider the length-only
schedule controller built from them, whose first administrative tape is the budget
tape.  If the budget tape currently reads a bit symbol $b$, then the transition out of
the borrow control phase with carry $c$ is the single-lane action on the budget tape
that writes the bit $b \oplus c$, moves right, and enters the borrow phase with carry
$c \wedge \lnot b$.
